market_pulse.theme: Global regulatory shifts across emerging and established markets
market_pulse.narrative: Regulators worldwide are tightening licensing, advertising, and consumer protection rules – from new gambling licences in Rwanda, penalty regimes in Kenya, SMS ad bans in Mozambique, to AI‑deepfake crackdowns in Thailand and new frameworks in Mauritius and the UK.

Several operators are moving into fresh markets – Play971 adding IGT and Endorphina titles, Greentube launching in Alberta, broader Alberta igaming rollout, Suntrust seeking accreditation in Westside City, and Fertitta Entertainment planning integration with Caesars to leverage US assets.

market_pulse.theme: Growth of prediction markets and innovative sports betting products
market_pulse.narrative: Prediction markets are gaining mainstream attention, highlighted by tribal gaming lobbying in Washington, the Love Island betting surge attracting new audiences, and DraftKings’ valuation being cut as prediction‑market dynamics reshape investor expectations.

market_pulse.theme: Responsible gambling and player protection initiatives
market_pulse.narrative: Operators and NGOs are emphasizing player safety – 1xCare forming an advisory committee, Kasinohai exposing hidden costs in casino bonuses, and BetBlocker stressing anonymity as a core element of harm‑reduction support.

market_pulse.theme: B2B leadership changes and industry consolidation
market_pulse.narrative: Key executive moves signal consolidation – ZEAL’s VP to lead SevenCanyon, Aristocrat hiring a former Light & Wonder COO, BetConstruct AI appointing a new CEO focused on AI‑driven tech stacks, and broader shifts in B2B marketing strategies.

portfolio_wins.topic: M&A activity in the US casino sector
portfolio_wins.our_narrative: We have early coverage of Carl Icahn’s last‑minute bid for Caesars, indicating strong monitoring of high‑profile casino M&A.
Our portfolio includes a dedicated internal piece on middle legal counsel, indicating in‑house legal expertise that can support operators navigating complex regulatory environments.

Our portfolio uniquely tracks the UK Gambling Commission’s consideration to suspend Evolution’s licence due to AML failings, providing early insight into regulatory risk for a major live‑casino provider.

portfolio_wins.topic: Conversational betting as a growth channel
portfolio_wins.our_narrative: Our internal coverage highlights BetCris’s view that conversational betting could become the next major growth driver for iGaming, positioning us ahead of competitors who have not yet covered this emerging channel.

portfolio_wins.topic: IGT’s strategic exit from electronic table games
portfolio_wins.our_narrative: We report on IGT’s decision to shutter its electronic table games division by 2027, providing early insight into supplier restructuring that competitors have not addressed.
